title: Rest
lead: The Bible's word for a settled, secure place where God's people belong: the Sabbath, the promised land, a home and a husband in Ruth, the temple as God's resting place, and in Hebrews a rest still to come for the people of God.

sections.b: God rested on the seventh day (Genesis 2:2–3), and the Sabbath commandment shares that rest with people, servants and animals (Exodus 20:8–11). The promised land is Israel's "rest" (Deuteronomy 12:9; Joshua 21:44), and the temple is God's "place of rest" (Psalm 132:8, 14). Psalm 95 warns a disobedient generation, "They will never come into my place of rest" (Psalm 95:11). Jesus invites the weary, "I will give you rest" (Matthew 11:28–29), and Hebrews reads Psalm 95 as pointing to "a Sabbath rest" still waiting for God's people (Hebrews 3:7–4:11).
